batchingRules: Never skip a phase or gate.
Batch file discovery/hash/classification across many files in one deterministic run.
Process every file through inventory/classification even when deep inspection is only needed for unique/conflicting/unknown families.
Reuse prior evidence only when SHA-256/content identity is unchanged.
Parallelize independent research, code analysis, implementation preparation, and test groups within the same phase.
Merge parallel outputs only after reconciliation checks detect conflicts and provenance is retained.
Run focused tests in parallel where test isolation permits; retain deterministic rerun on any failure.
No destructive cleanup until the relevant file family has been inspected/reconciled and rollback evidence exists.
No PASS if any mandatory sub-lane is incomplete, failed, ambiguous, or lacks evidence.
Checkpoint/push in verified phase batches while preserving the 25MB staged-file guard and excluding unrelated protected files.
conflictPolicy: Any disagreement between lanes is resolved before phase PASS; evidence wins over assumptions.
userSafetyInvariants: no trust in indexes without source-file evidence
